title: Plaintext Authentication Token Stored in SharedPreferences
description: Session bearer tokens are persisted directly in `SharedPreferences` (`prefs.setString('token', token)`), which writes unencrypted XML files to `/data/data/<package>/shared_prefs/`.
attack_vector: On a rooted device, via ADB backup extraction, or through local file-read vulnerabilities, an attacker reads the plaintext XML file and steals long-lived bearer tokens to hijack the user account.
fix_rationale: Persist authentication tokens exclusively in `FlutterSecureStorage` backed by Android Keystore (`EncryptedSharedPreferences`) and iOS Keychain.
